description:
Configure the global build tools for the Jenkins instance. Navigate to 'Manage Jenkins' > 'Tools' (or 'Global Tool Configuration') and configure the following:

1. Add a JDK installation:
   - Name: 'JDK-17'
   - Uncheck 'Install automatically'
   - JAVA_HOME: '/opt/java/openjdk'

2. Add a Maven installation:
   - Name: 'Maven-3.9.6'
   - Keep 'Install automatically' checked
   - Select Version: '3.9.6' (from Apache)

Save the configuration when finished. You are logged in as admin.
